description: This file contains the implementation of a PSR-7 URI class, including methods for parsing, composing, and manipulating URIs, as well as handling URI components and validation.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing URI parsing, composition, validation, and manipulation functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object by parsing the provided URI string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URI by composing its components.

methods.name: composeComponents
methods.description: Static method to compose a URI string from its individual components.

methods.name: isDefaultPort
methods.description: Checks if the URI uses the default port for its scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if the URI is absolute (has a scheme).

methods.name: isNetworkPathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a network-path reference.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is an absolute-path reference.

methods.name: isRelativePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a relative-path reference.

methods.name: isSameDocumentReference
methods.description: Determines if the URI is a same-document reference relative to a base URI.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments from a path, delegating to UriResolver.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI, delegating to UriResolver.

methods.name: withoutQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specific query parameter removed.

methods.name: withQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specific query parameter set or replaced.

methods.name: withQueryValues
methods.description: Creates a new URI with multiple query parameters set or replaced.

methods.name: fromParts
methods.description: Creates a Uri object from an array of parse_url components.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority component of the URI.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user info component.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified user info.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new Uri with the specified fragment.

methods.name: applyParts
methods.description: Applies parse_url components to the URI object.

methods.name: filterScheme
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates the scheme component.

methods.name: filterUserInfoComponent
methods.description: Sanitizes and encodes the user info component.

methods.name: filterHost
methods.description: Sanitizes and encodes the host component.

methods.name: filterPort
methods.description: Validates and filters the port number.

methods.name: getFilteredQueryString
methods.description: Filters out specified query parameters from a URI.

methods.name: generateQueryString
methods.description: Generates a query string key-value pair with proper encoding.

methods.name: removeDefaultPort
methods.description: Removes the port if it is the default for the scheme.

methods.name: filterPath
methods.description: Sanitizes and encodes the path component.

methods.name: filterQueryAndFragment
methods.description: Sanitizes and encodes query and fragment components.

methods.name: rawurlencodeMatchZero
methods.description: Performs rawurlencode on regex matches.

methods.name: validateState
methods.description: Validates the URI's internal state and consistency.
